collection_method: The official card-list JavaScript calls GET /web/CardList/cardList. This collector follows that endpoint in 30-card pages using offset, preserves sort_card_id_list order, and selects only those listed IDs from card_details.
scope: Cards returned by the Japanese official card library's default search. Related/generated token details bundled by the API are not added unless their IDs occur in sort_card_id_list.

schema.種類: フォロワー | スペル | アミュレット
schema.効果: string; official markup converted to plain text
schema.進化後効果: string for followers, possibly empty; null otherwise
schema.rarity: ブロンズレア | シルバーレア | ゴールドレア | レジェンド
schema.image_url: string or null; official base-card image URL
schema.evolved_image_hash: string or null; official evolved base-card image hash
schema.evolved_image_url: string or null; official evolved base-card image URL
schema.card_styles: array; alternate visual styles associated with this base card
schema.card_styles[].style_index: integer; one-based order in the official API style_card_list
schema.card_styles[].style_name: string; alternate style name, empty when the official API does not provide one
schema.card_styles[].evolved_image_hash: string or null; official evolved image hash
schema.card_styles[].evolved_image_url: string or null; official evolved image URL
schema.card_styles[].effect_override: string or null; style-specific effect text when supplied
schema.card_styles[].effective_effect: string; style override or inherited base-card effect
